description: Kubernetes-native network segmentation via NetworkPolicy resources that define pod-level ingress and egress rules. Enforces default-deny network posture and explicit allow rules based on pod selectors, namespace selectors, and IP blocks. Prevents lateral movement within cluster by restricting pod-to-pod communication to explicitly allowed paths. Requires CNI plugin support (Calico, Cilium, Weave, Antrea). Policies are namespace-scoped and stack additively.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Network attack vector restricted to adjacent pods/namespaces; default-deny blocks lateral movement
Scope change prevented; compromised pod cannot reach other namespaces without explicit policy

verification.method: Verify NetworkPolicy resources exist and CNI enforces them

commands.expected: NetworkPolicy resources exist for sensitive namespaces
policyTypes includes Ingress and/or Egress with rules defined
default-deny policy exists (empty podSelector = all pods)

commands.command: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l 'k8s-app in (calico-node, cilium, weave-net, antrea-agent)' | grep -c Running

platforms: Kubernetes with CNI plugin (Calico, Cilium, Weave, Antrea)

remediation.name: Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicy with explicit allow rules

steps.description: Apply a default-deny NetworkPolicy that blocks all ingress and egress traffic for every pod in the target namespace. Uses an empty podSelector to match all pods.
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
EOF

steps.description: Apply an explicit allow NetworkPolicy permitting required ingress and egress traffic for selected pods. Adjust podSelector, namespaceSelector, ports, and IP blocks to match the application's communication requirements.
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-app-traffic
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: <app-label>
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              name: <allowed-namespace>
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: <port>
  egress:
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              name: <allowed-namespace>
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: <port>
EOF

relationships.rationale: Enforces pod-level access control for network communication
Restricts communication channel to intended endpoints via explicit allow rules
Prevents incorrect resource transfer between pod security contexts
